title: Meta Jungle
tagline: Meta Jungle is metaverse open world game, where user can play, challenge each other, visit other user's virtual world and talk.
description:
Meta Jungle
Meta Jungle is metaverse open world game, where user can play, challenge each other, Buy NFT from in-game coins and create virtual world, they can also visit other user's virtual world. So now in-app items and achievements are not only statistic but it be used in game to create your own virtual world.

Features
- Multiplayer in metaverse game
- Interactive games to play alone or with online players
- Voice chat with other online players to interact
- Earn in-game coins and buy NFT (ERC-1155) within gamestore
- Each NFT will help to create virtual world

Technologies
- Unity Game Engine
- Metamask wallet for authentication
- NFT.Storage to store NFT data on IPFS/Filecoin
- Matic coin based on Polygon (Mumbai Testnet)
- Covalent to get user NFT balanace and NFT metadata
- Remix IDE used to create smart contract for ERC-1155
- Moralis to manage gameplay data
how_its_made:
This project uses Unity Game Engine which is best to develop game with knowledge of c#, Meta Mask wallet, IPFS and Filecoin used with NFT.Storage , Polygon Matic (Mumbai TestNet), ERC 1155 Contract, Covalent used to load user NFT balance and NFT metadata, Moralis is used for database storage and other backend communication management. Leantwean is used for internal UI animations. 
- Polygon's mumbai testnet made easy to create NFT ERC-1155 contract interact with it 
- Covalent API used to get user NFT balance and NFT metadata
- IPFS/Filecoin used to store NFT data on NFT.Storage
